quarterly_data.signal: Company deck update: July 2026 revenue NT$165,627K (US$5,115K), up 29.21% YoY; 2026 accumulated revenue NT$982,225K, down 2.89% YoY. In 1H26, IPs at 16nm and below account for nearly 63% of total license fee; the company says fabless customers are steadily kicking off 22-28nm new projects alongside an increasing number of new design starts below 16nm and 6nm, while foundry demand is shifting from mature to advanced nodes at 6nm and below.
